text:
tao: Heads-up — seeing ~120 pending GPU pods in us-west2. Most are tiny trainer jobs requesting 0.25g but nodes only have 0.125g fragments left. Scheduler logs show packing failures due to node taint `gpu-reserved=true:NoSchedule` + strict pod anti-affinity.

ops-bot: [Alert] GPUPool(us-west2-a): fragmentation=79% > threshold(70%). unschedulable_pods=118. avg_free_gpus_per_node=0.18

sam: Ugh. Did we change node shapes or slot sizing in the last rollout? Any recent scaling or rack profile changes?

maria: We rolled the small-slot binpack change yesterday (shrinkwrap-rollout). Sample nodes n-west2-a-23 and n-west2-a-24 show label `gpu.shape=rtx6000x` and taint `gpu-reserved=true:NoSchedule`. Example: free capacity on a node = 0.125 but pods request 0.25.

tao: That matches. The new fractional allocator enforces strict anti-affinity for tiny jobs — intended to avoid noisy co-tenancy, but now it's starving small pods and leaving unusable fragments.

natalie: Quick mitigations: 1) relax anti-affinity for pods with `job.tiny=true` (make it preferredDuringScheduling) for 48h; 2) temporarily untaint a small subset of nodes to allow compacting; 3) run a targeted drain/evict + reschedule to consolidate fragments.

sam: I like (2)+(3) for immediate relief. We can also flip `fractional-allow-compact=true` in scheduler config as a short-term toggle. Need to be careful with noisy neighbors.

maria: I'll run a query against recent evictions to see if this will increase evic rate on medium jobs. Cost note: packing small pods reduces spot churn, likely net cost down.

tao: Plan: I'll cordon n-west2-a-24 and drain it to force reschedule into adjacent nodes with headroom, then uncordon. If that doesn't free enough contiguous GPUs, we'll untaint two nodes to accept compaction.

natalie: I'll prepare the admission Webhook patch to downgrade anti-affinity for `job.tiny=true`. PR: https://git.redwood/sched/PR-482 — will request quick review from @sam

sam: Approving review now. Also please add an annotation so we can revert the change after 48h automatically: `x-redwood-temp-fix=slot-frag-2026-03`.

ops-bot: Deploybot: starting rollout of scheduler-config `fractional-allow-compact=true` to us-west2-canary. rollout_id=roll-9832

maria: After rollout, I can run `kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector=status.phase=Pending` and cross-reference `nodeSelector` to confirm tiny jobs are now schedulable. If pending remains >50, we will scale warm-pool +4GPUs.

tao: I'm starting the drain on n-west2-a-24 now: `kubectl drain n-west2-a-24 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60`.

sam: Hold the untaint until after the drain completes and we verify scheduling behavior. We should also watch network egress on those nodes — packing can spike NVLink/PCIe egress.

maria: Noted. I'll watch interconnect metrics: hawkeye dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/internal/infra/us-west2/gpu-interconnect

natalie: PR merged and webhook deployed to canary. rollout tag applied: `temp-soft-affinity-tiny`.

ops-bot: Deploybot: scheduler-config rollout in us-west2-canary progressed to 50% nodes; no crashloop detected. Monitoring pending_count metric.

tao: Drain finished. A lot of tiny pods rescheduled successfully. Pending count dropped to 34.

sam: Nice. Keep an eye for perf regressions on larger jobs. Who's owning the follow-up defrag job?

maria: I'll own a short-lived batch job that tries to compact fragments across the rack overnight. Will post job spec in #eng-platform.

tao: I'll update runbook `runbooks/fragmentation/compact-defrag.md` with our steps and rollback. Also adding checklist for untaint revert and webhook removal after 48h.

maria: FYI finance: expected spot-reduction ~10–15% if this stays. Filing FIN-743.

sam: Perfect. Ping when compactor job completes and we'll roll the changes back to strict anti-affinity if stable.

tao: Will post follow-up in ~2h with final numbers. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
